summary: Curate seven standalone applications and one integrated Arr Suite for disposable Nex lab testing

guide.reason: Package setup, authentication, storage boundaries and untested native limits need operator guidance.

api.reason: Existing Core package parser, settings, install/report and signed format-1 catalogue flows; no wire changes.

roadmap.reason: Catalogue curation does not accept native Phase 10 gates or change a product milestone.

state.reason: Repository packages add no durable product state; installed settings remain in the existing Core master application record and inventory/adoption flow.
